Three ways to use AI in any process: run it inside a repeatable process, use it to explain a process you're new to, or use it to build the process (software tool, Claude routine, n8n automation). Keyword: how to use AI in any process. Comment PROCESS. Master: Drive > Reels for CapCut > ai-three-process-uses > reel.mp4.
guide: Use AI in any process by working out which of three jobs you need it for: doing a step inside a repeatable process, explaining a process you're new to, or building the process itself. You need an AI assistant such as ChatGPT or Claude, plus a real process you work through.
1. Write down the process you want help with, in plain steps, and note whether you've run it several times already.
1. Pick the job: AI inside the process, AI to explain the process, or AI to build the process.
1. For AI inside the process, choose a process you've repeated often, then give ChatGPT or Claude one step with an example input and the output you expect.
1. For AI to explain a process, such as in a new job or department, paste the documents, emails or notes into ChatGPT or Claude and ask it to describe the process step by step in plain English.
1. For AI to build the process, ask Claude Code or ChatGPT (Codex) to produce one of three things: a small software tool, a Claude routine, or an n8n automation.
1. Run the result on a real example and check the output against what you would have done by hand.
1. Adjust the instructions until it matches, then reuse it each time the process comes round.
Watch out: pick one of the three jobs before you start, because mixing them in a single request gives vague results.

```
You are helping me use AI in a process. The process is <describe the process in a few sentences>. I have access to <ChatGPT / Claude / Claude Code / n8n>. I have run this process <number> times before, and my main goal is <use AI inside it / understand it / build it>.
First, ask me up to five short questions to fill any gaps. Then choose which of three approaches fits best: (1) put AI inside one repeatable step of the process, (2) explain the process to me in plain English, or (3) build the process as a small software tool, a Claude routine or an n8n automation.
Return: the approach you chose and why in two sentences, the numbered steps I should follow, the exact instructions or prompt to give the AI for each step, and a simple way to check the output against doing it by hand. If you recommend building something, list the tools I need and keep it to the smallest working version. Use plain English and British spelling, and do not assume I have technical experience. Use only the tools I have listed, and tell me before suggesting anything else.
```
